---
title: "All articles"
description: "All articles accepted into the R Journal."
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# List all article directories
article_dirs <- list.dirs("articles", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)

# Sort by article ID (descending - newest first)
article_dirs <- sort(article_dirs, decreasing = TRUE)

# Group by year
years <- unique(sub("-.*", "", sub("RJ-", "", article_dirs)))

for (year in years) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", year))
  year_articles <- article_dirs[grepl(paste0("RJ-", year, "-"), article_dirs)]
  for (art_id in year_articles) {
    pdf_path <- sprintf("articles/%s/%s.pdf", art_id, art_id)
    if (file.exists(pdf_path)) {
      cat(sprintf("[%s](%s)\n\n", art_id, pdf_path))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("%s\n\n", art_id))
    }
  }
}
```
